title: Secure LSL
description: Secure LSL is a drop-in replacement for liblsl that adds a transparent, unified encryption layer to the Lab Streaming Layer. It provides Ed25519 device authorization, per-session X25519 key exchange with a BLAKE2b key-derivation function, and ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, so existing LSL applications gain end-to-end security without code changes. A clean-room liblsl-ESP32 reimplementation extends the same encryption to microcontroller-class biosensors.
